annotations.title: Search schools, apps, exams and tutors

description: Search every way to learn Dutch: schools, universities, apps, podcasts, exams and online tutors. Use it when someone asks where or how to learn Dutch. Filters: city (Dutch or Flemish, e.g. Utrecht, Den Haag, Antwerpen), type, goal (e.g. inburgering, NT2, business, conversation), cefr, online, verified_pro, platform, kind. Each result has directory_url and primary_url to cite.
